reason: I'd take the free call and the 15-company list, but paying EUR 1,500 upfront to another outreach agency after the last one gave me slides and nothing is not happening this month. Also, I run an agency myself, so I know how easy it is to make a sample list look good.
objection: The 1,500 upfront is real money for me and it pays for setup I can't check. The 'qualified meeting' could just be someone polite who takes a call and never buys, and one logistics case study doesn't tell me it works for a small agency.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to a past client who runs an agency like mine and actually signed paying work from those meetings, or having the whole fee paid only per meeting with no upfront payment.
